title: SSO callback errors for SAML and OIDC logins
description: A subset of SAML and OIDC sign-ins fail at the callback step with a 502. Engineering is rolling back the identity gateway release. Password logins are unaffected.

title: Elevated API gateway latency
description: p95 latency on the public API was above 2 s for about 40 minutes. Resolved by scaling the gateway.

title: Degraded file uploads in eu-west
description: Large uploads timed out in eu-west. Resolved by replacing an unhealthy storage node.

title: Delayed Slack notification webhooks
description: Outbound Slack notifications were delayed by up to 15 minutes. Resolved after a queue worker restart.
